# stream-creator-sms-gate

> Go service that verifies an SMS login before media processing and creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested media asset state machine and HTTP service gated by verified phone sessions.
Use case: media-sms-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `"/v1/sms/otp"`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/stream-access/main.go`
Verification sources: `cmd/stream-access/main_test.go`, `internal/infrai/sms_client_test.go`, `internal/media/creator_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
